## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `ruff check src` is clean
- [ ] `yubel selftest` still succeeds
- [ ] New behavior has tests (parse-only fixtures for engines; predicate tests for chain rules)
- [ ] Docs updated if user-facing (README / ARCHITECTURE / CHANGELOG)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or data from unauthorized targets in the diff or tests
